parameter_contexts.promoter_configuration: BBa_J23101 constitutive regulator expression; cognate QS promoter; GFP reporter
parameter_contexts.induction_conditions: Overnight cultures diluted 1:100 into LB + chloramphenicol, grown 3 h at 37 °C and 250 rpm; diluted to OD600 0.1; 100 µL aliquots received 1:100 synthetic AHL stock.
parameter_contexts.exposure_time: 3 h AHL induction at 37 °C and 750 rpm after the 3 h pre-growth step
parameter_contexts.measurement_platform: Attune NxT flow cytometer; FlowJo v10 analysis
parameter_contexts.normalization_method: Host autofluorescence subtracted; four-parameter logistic fitting. Optional runtime demo applies within-context 0–1 normalization only.
parameter_contexts.background_subtraction: Mean autofluorescence of E. coli TOP10 carrying the reference plasmid was subtracted before fitting.

measurement_details.sample_dilution: 5–15 µL culture into 200 µL ice-cold PBS

parameter_contexts.vector_system: pBjk2807 regulator plasmids plus pBjk2992 promoter-sfGFP reporter plasmids
parameter_contexts.promoter_configuration: LuxR, LasR, engineered TraR(W)/Ptra*, and RpaR/Prpa* combinations
parameter_contexts.induction_conditions: Four HSL ligands, multiple concentrations, 64 promoter/receptor/ligand combinations
parameter_contexts.exposure_time: 3 h induction for reported dose-response summaries
parameter_contexts.background_subtraction: curve leak/basal retained in source analysis
parameter_contexts.notes: The publisher lists sb5b00286_si_001.xlsx (raw dose-response workbook) and sb5b00286_si_002.pdf (sequences/plasmids). The workbook payload was not stably retrievable in this revision; only main-text approximate values and Addgene identities are admitted.

parameter_contexts.promoter_configuration: hybrid Lux-box-like QS promoters; constitutively expressed regulator; GFP reporter
parameter_contexts.induction_conditions: Synthetic HSL specificity assays used 10^-14–10^-4 M; sender supernatants were tested at 10%, 25% and 50% where applicable.
parameter_contexts.exposure_time: 8 h time course at 37 °C; OD600 and GFP measured every 10 min; maximum GFP/OD600 rate used for dose-response summaries
parameter_contexts.measurement_platform: BioTek Synergy H1 microplate reader; 300 µL per well; maximum shaking 807 cpm
parameter_contexts.normalization_method: reported approximate Km and βmax; source precision retained
parameter_contexts.notes: RhlR failure and RpaR high basal apply only to this construct/context.

parameter_contexts.vector_system: pTetR bicistronic synthase/mCherry sender; F2620_EGFP receiver
parameter_contexts.culture_medium: LB supplemented with ampicillin 5 µg/mL for sender cultures
parameter_contexts.induction_conditions: Sender cultures grown 16 h; cell-free medium obtained by centrifugation at 4500×g for 5 min and filtration through a 0.22 µm nylon filter; receiver assays used 10%, 25% and 50% filtered sender medium.
parameter_contexts.exposure_time: Sender culture: 16 h. Receiver exposure: 240 min with EGFP and OD600 readings every 10 min.
parameter_contexts.normalization_method: GFP/OD600 at 240 min normalized to constitutive pLac-EGFP control; triplicate wells
parameter_contexts.background_subtraction: Mock-enriched medium from pTetR-mCherry sender control; untransformed/background controls as described
parameter_contexts.notes: Intermediate HSL species and concentrations were not directly measured.

parameter_contexts.vector_system: SEVA plasmids: low-copy RK2 receiver context and medium-copy pBBR1 sender context; study uses pSEVA621/pSEVA221/pSEVA238-derived modules
parameter_contexts.promoter_configuration: BBa_J23101 receiver regulator; XylS-Pm sender induction by 3-methylbenzoate
parameter_contexts.culture_medium: LB; kanamycin 50 µg/mL or gentamicin 10 µg/mL according to plasmid; P. putida cultured at 30 °C and 200 rpm
parameter_contexts.induction_conditions: cognate synthetic AHL dose response; one-strain and two-strain 3MBz induction configurations
parameter_contexts.exposure_time: 96-well assays initiated at OD600 0.1; 100 µL per well; plate incubation with 400 rpm shaking; source-specific endpoint/time course retained
parameter_contexts.notes: Parameters are retained as P. putida reference data and are not transferred to E. coli.

parameter_contexts.vector_system: pACYC184 EsaR expression vector plus pCS26 luxCDABE reporter
parameter_contexts.promoter_configuration: Plac-EsaR; PesaR or PesaS controls luxCDABE
parameter_contexts.normalization_method: luminescence normalized by OD600; Hill coefficient set to 1 for fit
parameter_contexts.notes: PesaR and PesaS must be modeled with opposite signal directions.
Construction identity is admitted; historical graph values were not re-transcribed into runtime parameters.
